1.title: The LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia
1.subtitle: His proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put in writing.

1.title: Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels
1.subtitle: Mithredath the treasurer numbers them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.

2.title: Every one unto his city
2.subtitle: The children of the province go up out of the captivity, with their horses, camels and asses.

3.title: They set the altar upon his bases
3.subtitle: Jeshua and Zerubbabel offer burnt offerings morning and evening, for fear was upon them.

3.title: The noise of the shout of joy
3.subtitle: The foundation of the house is laid; the old men who had seen the first house weep.

4.title: Ye have nothing to do with us
4.subtitle: Zerubbabel and Jeshua refuse the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin.

4.title: Then ceased the work of the house of God
4.subtitle: A letter to Artaxerxes, and the work made to cease by force and power.

5.title: Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo
5.subtitle: Zerubbabel and Jeshua rise up and begin to build again.

5.title: Who hath commanded you to build this house
5.subtitle: Tatnai the governor comes to the builders, and writes to Darius.

6.title: In the house of the rolls
6.subtitle: At Achmetha a roll is found: the decree of Cyrus concerning the house of God.

6.title: Kept the dedication of this house of God with joy
6.subtitle: The house finished in the sixth year of Darius, and the passover kept.

7.title: A ready scribe in the law of Moses
7.subtitle: Ezra goes up from Babylon, for he had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD.

7.title: Blessed be the LORD God of our fathers
7.subtitle: The letter of king Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest.

8.title: I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava
8.subtitle: Ezra was ashamed to ask the king for a band of soldiers.

8.title: Weighed unto them the silver, and the gold
8.subtitle: The vessels given into the hands of twelve chief priests for the journey.

9.title: Sat down astonied
9.subtitle: Ezra rends his garment and his mantle, and prays at the evening sacrifice.

10.title: The people wept very sore
10.subtitle: Ezra weeping and casting himself down before the house of God.

10.title: Trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain
10.subtitle: All the men of Judah and Benjamin sit in the street of the house of God.

10.title: They gave their hands
10.subtitle: The sons of the priests pledge themselves, and offer a ram for their trespass.
